Our Performance
This economic operating environment impacted Stanbic Holdings Plc operations and profitability, leading to a
stagnated outcome in profit after tax for the year.
However, the Group managed to maintain a profit after tax of KES 13.7 billion for the year attributed to our core
lending and improved asset quality. The Group’s loans and advances to customers increased by 16% year‑on‑year
and customer deposits grew by 5% signalling customer confidence. In addition, there was a 24.5% decrease in
Non‑interest Income (NFI) which fell to KES 7.8 billion impacting on our bottom line. The balance sheet remained
resilient anchored in strategic lending to key growth sectors in the economy, such as agriculture, SMEs and retail
customers. The Group remained disciplined on cost, proactive on risk, and focused on strategic value drivers
aligned to our “One Stanbic 2024–2026” strategy.
